subject: Re: kitchen remodel
body:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for coming by on Monday. You said you'd send the revised quote with the quartz countertop option by 2026-10-23, so I can show it to my husband over the weekend.

Also, could the island have an outlet on the side? We'd like to plug in the mixer there.

Maria

subject: Kitchen in our old house
body:
Hello, a neighbour gave me your name. We just bought a 1950s house and the kitchen needs a full redo: cabinets, counters, sink. Could you send me your rates and a rough timeline by 2026-10-26? We'd like it done before my parents visit in the spring.

Thanks,
Dev

subject: Two small things
body:
Hi Alex! While you're here, could you also tile the backsplash behind the stove? And the new pantry door doesn't close all the way, it bounces back open.

Thank you!! Maria

subject: It looks amazing
body:
Alex! We opened this morning with the new back counter and shelves, and three customers asked who did it. The baristas say it's so much easier to work behind the bar now. You were great to work with, thank you!

Noah

subject: Walkthrough + dishwasher leak
body:
Hey Alex! Can we push our final walkthrough to 2026-10-26? Something came up on my side. Also, last week you mentioned you'd fix the leak under the new sink this week. Is that still the plan? It still drips into the cabinet when the dishwasher runs.

Jordan
